title: Let objectives be marked complete or removed from the live list, without deleting the data
requested_outcome: There is currently no way to mark an objective complete or remove it so it stops showing in objective_list — only its individual facts, blockers and unknowns can be resolved one by one, and the objective itself stays active. Build a way to close an objective out (complete or removed) so it no longer appears in the live list, while keeping its full record — facts, notes, history — intact and retrievable later by its id or by searching, in case it turns out to hold something useful. Nothing should be deleted outright.
acceptance_criteria: An objective can be marked complete or removed through a tool call, given its objective_id
A closed objective (complete or removed) no longer appears in objective_list's live results
A closed objective's full record — facts, notes, blockers, history — is still retrievable afterwards, either by its id directly or by a search/listing of closed objectives
No data belonging to a closed objective is deleted
The change is proven by tests in crooks-assistant/tests/test_let_objectives_marked_complete_or_removed_3.py, and they pass.
